_comment: Per-carline config for the monthly Sprint Room run. chart_roles maps a role to the chartN.xml the skeleton builder produces for the NEW month's slide (skill duplicates last month's charts into 9-12). Verify against the actual deck when verify_chart_roles is true. See ../../docs/slide-configs.md. noise_patterns: case-insensitive regex fragments that `run.py flags` uses to surface off-topic rows in the raw export (candidate boolean exclusions - reviewed, never auto-dropped).

Explorer.notes: Original template; the skill's documented default order. 'Explorer' is a generic word: ~20% of raw rows (Aug-2026) were the French verb, mining stocks, a guitar, drones, boats, Pokémon Go. require_context lists the words a real Ford Explorer row carries; rows with none are surfaced by `run.py flags`. Watch the Spanish dealer-PR syndications (one 'Ford Nicolás' release = 59 rows on 30-31 Aug 2026).

Kuga.notes: EU5. build_skeleton hardcodes EU7 in the subtitle regex - fix subtitle manually. Sentiment series names are Capitalised ('Positive Pre'/'Negative Pre').

Capri.notes: EU7; 6 competitors. Watch the towing-PR NEAR/5 query asymmetry vs Explorer. Noise sources seen Aug-2026: GTA 6 'Capri' city RTs (10 in one day), a porn performer, Capri-island travel/fashion, Norwegian company 'Capri AS', and classic 1970s/80s Capri content. Heritage-vs-new-Capri backlash tweets are NOT noise - they are the X story.

Puma.notes: EU5; 4 competitors (NOT 6). 'Puma' is also a sportswear brand, an animal and a military vehicle: ~10% of raw rows (Aug-2026) had no Ford/car context. A further ~20-25% of raw Puma rows are WRC coverage of the Puma Rally1 / M-Sport race car - decide with Val whether motorsport is in scope; the cleaned Aug-2026 file excludes it under its own label. Peugeot 2008 boolean also catches '2008' as a year; T-Cross boolean catches generic VW/Golf/Polo pieces. Chart order is known to be swapped from the Explorer template (source deck has platform/sentiment in different positions). chart_roles verified on the July-2026 deck (chart1 volume, chart2 country, chart3 platform, chart4 sentiment; 5 sentiment categories Kona, 2008, Yaris Cross, T-Cross, Puma; diamonds named 'Positive <Month>'/'Negative <Month>'). build_skeleton EU7 subtitle bug applies here too.
